brief: Li-Ion charge controller driver for the Power.L.1T tile (rev a).
description:
Embeds the Texas Instruments BQ25150, a single-cell Li-Ion charge
controller with programmable 1.8 V LDO output and 12-bit ADC for
battery and system monitoring.

Key specifications:
  - Charge input:     3.4–5.5 V (up to 500 mA)
  - Battery voltage:  3.6–4.6 V (programmable in 10 mV steps)
  - LDO output:       1.8 V on this tile (chip is programmable)
  - ADC:              12-bit, 6 input channels
  - Charge current:   1.25–500 mA programmable
  - JEITA-style NTC:  cold / cool / warm / hot thresholds

Datasheet: https://www.bergsonne.io/tiles/power/l1t
IC datasheet: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25150.pdf

@studio tile label=Power.L.1T icon=☷


Driver gaps (chip capabilities not exposed by this driver):

@studio unsupported severity=advanced category="MR button + INT pin handling"
  The chip's MR (push-button) and INT (interrupt) pins aren't
  routed to tile pads on the current revision — nothing for a
  Core GPIO to attach to. Closing this gap requires a tile
  hardware revision that routes at least INT to a connector
  pad. Until then, MASK0–3 / MRCTRL register writes have no
  external effect.

structs.name: power_l_1t_status_t
structs.brief: Snapshot of the BQ25150's current state and latched faults.
structs.description:
Populated by tile_power_l_1t_get_charge_status(). Mixes live state
(vin_pgood, charging, *_active) and clear-on-read event flags
(faults). Reading the flags clears them — call once per polling
cycle, not multiple times.

functions.brief: Initialize the BQ25150 charge controller.
functions.description:
Verifies the device ID, disables the I²C watchdog (the chip
otherwise resets all charge parameters every 50 s), enables all
6 ADC channels, configures sane charge defaults, and exits ship
mode. Pass cfg=NULL for defaults.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_init

functions.brief: Set the fast-charge current.
functions.description:
Programs ICHG_CTRL with the appropriate ICHARGE_RANGE bit so the
resolution scales: ≤318 mA uses 1.25 mA steps, >318 mA uses
2.5 mA steps. Values clamp to 1.25–500 mA.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_charge_current_ma

functions.brief: Set the battery regulation voltage.
functions.description:
VBATREG = 3600 + code × 10 mV. Values outside 3600–4600 mV clamp
to that range. Use 4200 for typical Li-Ion, 3650 for LFP, 4350+
for high-voltage NMC variants.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_charge_voltage_mv

functions.brief: Set the pre-charge current (used when VBAT < VLOW).
functions.description:
Pre-charge applies to deeply-discharged cells; usually 10–20 % of
the fast-charge rate. Values clamp to 1.25–77.5 mA.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_pre_charge_ma

params.name: pct
params.description: Termination current as % of ICHG (0 = disabled, 1–31)

functions.brief: Set the termination current as a percentage of ICHG.
functions.description:
Charging ends when the cell's current draw drops below this
threshold during the CV phase. 0 disables termination (charges
continuously until VBATREG is reached). Values clamp to 1–31 %.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_termination_percent

functions.brief: Set the input current limit (DPM threshold).
functions.description:
When the adapter can't supply more than this, charge current
folds back to keep VIN above the DPM threshold. Values clamp to
5–500 mA in 5 mA steps.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_input_current_limit_ma

functions.brief: Read battery voltage from the ADC.
functions.description:
Replaces the deprecated raw-counts API; performs a 2-byte burst
read to avoid torn samples.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_vbat_mv

functions.brief: Read input (VIN) voltage from the ADC.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_vin_mv

functions.brief: Read PMID (system rail) voltage from the ADC.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_pmid_mv

functions.brief: Read charge current (into the battery) from the ADC.
functions.description:
Scaled relative to the configured ICHG fast-charge limit; returns
actual mA flowing into the cell.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_charge_current_ma

functions.brief: Read input current (from VIN) from the ADC.
functions.description:
Range scales with ILIMCTRL: ≤150 mA range gives 0–375 mA full
scale; >150 mA range gives 0–750 mA full scale.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_input_current_ma

functions.brief: Read raw TS pin voltage from the ADC.
functions.description:
Returns the millivolt reading on the TS pin (0–1200 mV). Convert
to °C using the NTC's resistance/temperature curve in firmware —
the chip doesn't expose temperature directly.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_ts_mv

functions.brief: Read raw ADCIN pin voltage from the ADC.
functions.description:
Optional auxiliary input (0–1.2 V range). Useful for monitoring
an external sensor (e.g., separate NTC, voltage divider).
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_adcin_mv

functions.brief: Read battery state-of-charge as a percentage.
functions.description:
Derived from VBAT using a linear curve (3000 mV = 0%, 4200 mV =
100%). Coarse — a real fuel gauge would integrate Coulombs.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_percent

functions.brief: Set the cold-temperature TS threshold (raw register value).
functions.description:
The TS register codes are bit-positional (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, ...
encode multiples of 4.688 mV up to 600 mV). Datasheet section
8.5.1.49–52 describes the exact mapping; users tuning JEITA
thresholds should consult the chip's NTC profile guide.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_ts_cold

functions.brief: Set the cool-temperature TS threshold (raw register value).
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_ts_cool

functions.brief: Set the warm-temperature TS threshold (raw register value).
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_ts_warm

functions.brief: Set the hot-temperature TS threshold (raw register value).
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_ts_hot

functions.brief: Enable or disable TS-based thermal protection.
functions.description:
When disabled, the chip ignores the NTC entirely (charging
proceeds regardless of battery temperature). Default at init: enabled.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_ts_enabled

functions.brief: Set the LDO output voltage.
functions.description:
VLDO = 600 + code × 100 mV. Values clamp to 600–3700 mV. Tile
design gates this rail to a fixed 1.8 V at the connector — changing
the LDO voltage breaks downstream peripherals expecting 1.8 V on
pad 10. Useful for non-default tile variants or load-switch-mode
pass-through use.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_ldo_voltage_mv

functions.brief: Set the LS/LDO output mode (regulated LDO vs load switch).
functions.description:
In LDO mode the chip regulates pad 10 to the configured voltage
(10 mA max). In load-switch mode it pass-through-connects PMID
via a FET (up to 150 mA, but VINLS must be tied to the desired
supply on the tile PCB).
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_ldo_mode

functions.brief: Enable or disable the LS/LDO output.
functions.description:
When disabled, pad 10 (V+) goes high-impedance — downstream rails
expecting 1.8 V will drop. Default at init: enabled (chip default).
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_ldo_enabled

functions.brief: Snapshot the chip's current state + latched faults.
functions.description:
Reads STAT0/STAT1 (live state) and FLAG0/FLAG1/FLAG3 (event flags
which clear on read) into the supplied struct. Call once per
polling cycle — multiple reads will lose flag transitions.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_charge_status

functions.brief: Enter ship mode (~10 nA quiescent).
functions.description:
Disconnects the battery internally; only an MR press or VIN
insertion will wake the chip. Charge parameters reset to defaults
on exit. Use only for long-term storage / end-of-line packaging.

re-insertion) to recover. Marked `section=advanced` for the same
posture as other one-way / hardware-gated operations.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_enter_ship_mode

functions.brief: Read any 8-bit BQ25150 register.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_read_status

functions.signature: void tile_power_l_1t_write_reg(tile_t* tile, uint8_t reg, uint8_t value)
functions.brief: Write any 8-bit BQ25150 register.
functions.description:
Escape hatch for advanced users wanting to touch registers the
driver doesn't expose. Caller is responsible for not bricking the
chip — most useful registers have typed setters above.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_write_reg

functions.brief: Is the cell currently being charged?
functions.description:
Convenience over @ref tile_power_l_1t_get_charge_status — returns
the `charging` field as a bool. Note this reads (and clears) FLAG3
as a side effect; if you also poll the full status struct, alternate
with this rather than calling both per cycle.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_is_charging

functions.return: 1 if charge cycle has finished, 0 otherwise
functions.brief: Has charge termination been reached?
functions.description:
Returns the `charge_done` bit from STAT0 — set when the cell
reaches VBATREG and current tapers below the termination threshold.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_is_charge_done

functions.return: 1 if battery percent is strictly below threshold, 0 otherwise
functions.brief: Is the battery below `threshold_pct`?
functions.description:
The classic "go to sleep" trigger. Equivalent to
`get_percent() < threshold_pct`. Quick: one ADC read.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_is_battery_low

functions.return: 1 if VIN is good, 0 if running off battery only
functions.brief: Is external power present (running off VIN)?
functions.description:
Returns the `vin_pgood` bit — true when VIN is in the valid
operating range (3.4–5.5 V). Use to branch behaviour between
"plugged in" and "battery only" modes.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_is_powered

params.name: timeout_ms
params.description: Maximum time to wait, in milliseconds

functions.return: 1 if charge_done was observed, 0 on timeout
functions.brief: Block until charge_done is observed, or timeout.
functions.description:
Polls the charge_done bit at a 1 s cadence (charge state changes
on the order of minutes for a typical cell — faster polling wastes
MCU cycles and bus bandwidth without finer-grained answers).
Returns 1 immediately if the cycle is already finished.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_wait_for_charge_done

functions.brief: Enable or disable battery charging over I²C.
functions.description:
Sets/clears ICCTRL2.CHARGER_DISABLE. Note the hardware /CE pin still
gates charging: when /CE is high, charging is off regardless of this
bit; this only takes effect when /CE is held low (the tile's default).
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_charger_enable

functions.brief: Set the battery under-voltage lockout (discharge cutoff) threshold.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_battery_uvlo_mv

functions.brief: Set the charge safety-timer limit.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_safety_timer

functions.brief: Set the PMID power-path mode (ICCTRL1[1:0]).
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_pmid_mode

functions.signature: void tile_power_l_1t_set_adc_comparator(tile_t* tile, uint8_t comp, power_l_1t_adc_channel_t channel, uint16_t threshold)
functions.brief: Configure a programmable ADC comparator (threshold alarm).
functions.description:
Routes ADC channel `channel` to comparator `comp` (1-3) and sets its
16-bit threshold (left-justified, same scale as the channel's ADC
result). When the measurement crosses the threshold, the matching
COMPn_ALARM bit latches in FLAG2 (read via get_adc_comparators()).
Pass channel = POWER_L_1T_ADC_CH_DISABLED to turn a comparator off.

Note: the chip's above/below polarity bit (ADCALARM_ABOVE) is not
exposed by this driver yet — the comparator uses its default sense.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_set_adc_comparator

functions.return: BQ25150_FLAG2_COMPn_ALARM bits that have tripped since last read.
functions.brief: Read (and clear) the ADC comparator alarm flags.
functions.name: tile_power_l_1t_get_adc_comparators
